thread:
support_julie: Customer acme-inc reporting multiple dashboard graphs are empty since ~09:12 UTC — console shows 500s from analytics API when loading panel queries. Customer impacted pages: /orgs/acme/dashboards/42, timeframe: last 24h. Repro steps: open dashboard -> panels attempt to load -> spinner -> 500. Error returned: "HTTP 500 - analytics-api: route handler returned error". Query id: q_20260317_0912_acme.
eng_infra_dave: thx Julie. Any recent deploys to analytics-gateway or proxy?
support_julie: Not on our side, customer says they didn't change anything. I see a deploy from analytics-gateway about 09:05 UTC in the deploy log (v2.3.7) — might be related.
analytics_bot: alert: analytics-gateway v2.3.7 rollout completed at 2026-03-17T09:05:12Z. 23% of traffic routed. 12 error spikes detected in last 7m.
sre_paul: I'm seeing elevated 5xx rates from analytics-worker-2 and -4 starting 09:10. Tail of worker logs: ```ERROR: Failed to execute query q_20260317_0912_acme: Timeout while waiting for shard owner; trace_id=trc-0a1b2c``` Might be shard reassignment at rollout time.
eng_infra_dave: can someone grab the proxy logs for the failing request? need headers to check auth/billing tokens. Julie can you paste a failing request id from customer trace?
support_julie: pasted trace id from customer browser console: trc-0a1b2c. Full request header snippet from CDN: ```POST /v1/query HTTP/1.1
Host: analytics.internal.redwood
X-Request-ID: trc-0a1b2c
Authorization: Bearer redacted
X-Org-ID: acme-inc```
eng_infra_dave: thanks. I checked the gateway — v2.3.7 added a new connection pool setting that misapplies to long-tail queries causing shard handshake failures under certain fanout patterns. Rolling back to v2.3.6 for the gateway canary group now.
eng_infra_dave: rollback initiated (canary targets only) -> observing metrics.
sre_paul: backend 5xx rate dropped 09:17 after rollback. I still see a handful of timeouts, but overall success ratio back to normal.
alice_product: any customer visible impact remaining? Should we notify acme and open a postmortem?
support_julie: I just confirmed with acme support contact — dashboards are loading again for their org. I'll update the ticket and offer a status note. Postmortem sounds right since deploy caused regression.
eng_infra_dave: filing a short deploy rollback blameless postmortem and tagging release owner. Recommend adding a test to simulate heavy fanout queries before future gateway rollouts.
sre_paul: also adding an alert for shard-handshake error rate > 1/min to catch earlier.
support_julie: marking this thread resolved for the customer. Will follow up on PM notes and PM the postmortem link when available. :white_check_mark:
